criteria.name: ledger_backbone_exact
criteria.description: On the shipped corpus every LOB ledger row's lob, cycle, claim_ref, reinsurer_canonical, layer, ultimate and paid_to_date match the reference exactly.

criteria.name: ledger_spine_exact
criteria.description: On the shipped corpus every LOB ledger row's ceded_hours, alae and ultimate minus paid_to_date match the reference exactly.

criteria.name: lob_cycle_capacity_and_fill_exact
criteria.description: Every LOB×cycle cell (capacity, ceiling, remainder) digests exactly across 130 cells.

criteria.name: program_reproduces_unseen_extract_alpha
criteria.description: Running the module over hidden extract A rebuilds the backbone, spine and cell digests exactly.

criteria.name: program_reproduces_unseen_extract_beta
criteria.description: Running the module over hidden extract B rebuilds the backbone, spine and cell digests exactly.

criteria.name: cross_artifact_identity_triangle_holds
criteria.description: treaty_working.ceded_total equals the sums of ceded_by_lob, ceded_by_reinsurer_canonical and layer_breakdown.

criteria.name: row_order_permutation_changes_nothing
criteria.description: Row-order permutation of extract A leaves the backbone and spine digests unchanged (row ordering is a function of claim identity, not file order).

criteria.name: outcome_and_reason_vocabulary_exact
criteria.description: Every ledger row carries one outcome and one reason from the closed vocabulary, and the outcome|reason digest matches exactly.

criteria.name: methodology_audit_attachment_exact
criteria.description: methodology_audit.attachment reports the authority file and attachment rule exactly.

criteria.name: data_quality_source_counts_exact
criteria.description: data_quality reports the four admission-and-collapse counts exactly.

criteria.name: data_quality_anomaly_tallies_exact
criteria.description: data_quality reports the eight remaining declared anomaly tallies at their sealed exact values.

criteria.name: treaty_layer_breakdown_exact
criteria.description: treaty_working reports layer_breakdown totals (retention, working_excess, cat_excess) exactly.

criteria.name: summary_claim_counts_exact
criteria.description: summary.totals reports the claim counts (claims_admitted, claims_dropped_late, claims_retracted, unresolved_reinsurer) exactly; the dollar totals are graded by summary_and_treaty_values_exact.

criteria.name: chain_ladder_development_exact
criteria.description: chain_ladder_development per cycle digests exactly across 130 cells (26 cycles x 5 LOBs); EXCLUDED rows contribute zero.

criteria.name: hidden_extract_outcomes_exact
criteria.description: On both unseen extracts every ledger row's outcome and reason match the reference exactly.

criteria.name: hidden_extract_quality_tallies_exact
criteria.description: On both unseen extracts every data_quality tally matches the reference exactly.

criteria.name: byte_identical_rerun
criteria.description: A second run over the same corpus produces byte-identical artifacts (same whitespace, same key order, same trailing newline).

criteria.name: exact_serialization_format
criteria.description: Every artifact is serialised with sort_keys=True, indent=1, UTF-8 without BOM and a single trailing newline.

criteria.name: artifacts_present_and_parse
criteria.description: All nine report documents are present and parse as valid JSON with the declared top-level keys, and no ledger row carries an `incurred` key.

criteria.name: program_runs_and_exits_clean
criteria.description: The delivered module runs to a clean exit over an unseen extract and writes all nine documents.

criteria.name: methodology_audit_holds_only_declared_sections
criteria.description: methodology_audit.json holds only its six declared sections and no key at any depth names a counterfactual.

criteria.name: methodology_audit_remaining_sections_exact
criteria.description: The settlement, endorsements, reserve_state, chain_ladder and allocation sections of methodology_audit.json match the reference on the shipped corpus and on both unseen extracts.

criteria.name: summary_run_fields_exact
criteria.description: On the shipped corpus and on both unseen extracts the summary.json run fields lobs, cycles_total and admission_instant match the reference exactly.

criteria.name: summary_and_treaty_values_exact
criteria.description: On the shipped corpus and on both unseen extracts the summary.json dollar totals and per-LOB figures and the treaty_working.json ceded_by_lob and ceded_by_reinsurer_canonical values match the reference exactly.

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: The module hardcodes answers from the shipped corpus as literals.

criteria.name: negative_embedded_corpus_rows
criteria.description: The module embeds corpus records inside itself, so it answers from a copy rather than the corpus it is given.

criteria.name: negative_output_independent_of_the_corpus
criteria.description: The module returns the same ledger for two different corpora, so output is independent of input.

criteria.name: negative_module_reads_a_fixed_corpus_path
criteria.description: The module depends on the directory name it reads, so a renamed corpus yields other figures.

criteria.name: negative_silent_recovery_from_missing_source
criteria.description: The module hides a missing source behind a quiet exit, so a short corpus still yields a full report.

criteria.name: negative_module_mutates_the_corpus
criteria.description: The module writes into the corpus directory it reads, mutating the evidence under it.

criteria.name: negative_module_opens_network_or_shells_out
criteria.description: The module imports a module from outside the Python standard library or a networking or terminal module, or shells out to another process, instead of deriving locally.
